book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: حصان سباق غالي اختفى، والمدرب انلقى ميت.
sentences.en: A valuable racehorse disappeared, and the trainer was found dead.

sentences.ar: الشرطة كانت ماسكة واحد غريب شافوه بالليل.
sentences.en: The police were holding a stranger who had been seen at night.

sentences.ar: رحنا عالمزرعة وهولمز قعد يسأل عن العشا.
sentences.en: We went to the farm and Holmes began asking about the supper.

sentences.ar: قال: العشا كان لحمة بالكاري، صح؟
sentences.en: He said: the supper was curried mutton, correct?

sentences.ar: لستراد قال: وشو دخل الأكل بالموضوع؟
sentences.en: Lestrade said: and what has the food to do with it?

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: الكاري بيخبي طعم أي إشي بتحطه فيه.
sentences.en: Holmes said: curry hides the taste of anything you put in it.
